question: Five friends A, S, D, F and G took admission in a coaching institute in consecutive months of the same calendar year. A took admission in May. Only D took admission between F and S, while G took admission exactly one month after A. F was the last one to take admission. In which month did D take admission?
solution:
​**Given Information:**

 
• Five friends A, S, D, F and G took admission in consecutive months of the same calendar year.
 
• A took admission in May.
 
• Only D took admission between F and S.
 
• G took admission exactly one month after A.
 
• F was the last one to take admission.

**Step-by-step Deduction:**

1. **A took admission in May.**

4. **Only D took admission between F and S.**

This means the order of these three friends must be S, D, F. With F in September, S must be in July and D in August.
